title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Account Agreement — Tenure Reduction of a Re-Rated Late Fee
content:
When the most recent late fee on a Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account is re-rated, a long-held account with a clean payment record receives a tenure reduction: a dollar amount taken off the scheduled late fee, the reduced fee never falling below zero.

| Account open | Payments returned on the account in the last 24 months | Tenure reduction |
|---|---|---|
| At least 60 whole months | None | 4.00 (long-tenure reduction) |
| At least 24 and less than 60 whole months | None | 2.00 (middle-tenure reduction) |
| Any other case — open less than 24 whole months, or a payment returned in the last 24 months | | Zero |

Account age is counted in whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the correction date, and the 24 months are whole calendar months counted back from the correction date. A returned payment is shown by a returned payment line on the account.

## Cases (hypothetical, scheduled late fee 25.00)

| Account open | Returned payments in 24 months | Reduction | Scheduled fee after this reduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 60 months | 0 | 4.00 | 21.00 |
| 59 months | 0 | 2.00 | 23.00 |
| 24 months | 0 | 2.00 | 23.00 |
| 23 months | 0 | 0.00 | 25.00 |
| 96 months | 1 | 0.00 | 25.00 |
